info.name: Stedi Healthcare Claims Claim acknowledgments Events API

params.name: eventId
params.description: The ID of the event you want Stedi to re-emit.

items.docs: This endpoint retriggers the specified processing event.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of elements to return in a page. If not specified, the default is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The `nextPageToken` value from a previous response. You can use this to get the next page of results. If not set, Stedi returns the first page of results.

params.name: eventId
params.description: Filter results by event ID, such as `evt_019d554b-311b-7813-b491-0a8973762eae`.

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter results by one or more event statuses. Can be:
  - `DELIVERED`: Stedi successfully delivered the event to all relevant event destinations.
  - `PENDING`: Stedi is still trying to deliver the event to one or more event destinations.
  - `FAILED`: Stedi couldn't deliver the event to at least one event destination and is no longer retrying.

params.name: eventType
params.description: Filter results by event type, such as `enrollment.activated`.

params.name: created
params.description:
Filter results by their `createdAt` timestamp. Each value is in the format `operator:ISO-8601-timestamp`.
  - The supported operators are `gt` (after), `gte` (at or after), `lt` (before), and `lte` (at or before). For example: Setting this to `lt:2024-02-01T00:00:00Z` filters for events created before the specified timestamp.
  - Combine multiple values with `&` to specify a date range. For example: `created=gt:2026-01-01T00:00:00Z&created=lt:2026-02-01T00:00:00Z`.

items.docs: Lists all events for your account. Results are paginated.

params.name: eventId
params.description: The unique identifier for the event, formatted as `evt_{UUID}`.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of an existing event by its identifier.
